export_rights.summary: Deel's terms of service and DPA were not consulted, so the contractual export-rights statement and any post-termination retrieval window are undocumented here. Deel's own API documentation (consulted via mirrors and its official SDK) shows that a tenant admin can generate scoped bearer tokens and programmatically retrieve the organization's people, contract, timesheet, payroll, invoice, and document data via the public REST API.

routes.how: Deel REST API v2 at https://api.letsdeel.com/rest/v2, Authorization: Bearer <token>. Token generated in-app: Apps & Perks > Developer Center > Generate New Token (shown once). Paginated GET list endpoints include /people, /contracts, /timesheets, /time_offs, /invoices, /invoices/deel (Deel's own fee invoices), /payments plus /payments/{payment_id}/breakdown, /adjustments, /legal-entities, /teams, /organizations, /candidates, and SCIM-style /Users and /Users/.search for user profiles.
requires: organization admin access to Developer Center to generate an API token

token scopes per endpoint family, e.g. people:read, contracts:read, timesheets:read, time-off:read, accounting:read, payslips:read, global-payroll:read, invoice-adjustments:read, benefits:read, worker:read
routes.rate_limits: Not numerically documented in consulted sources. Mirrored API metadata reports per-token limits returning HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header and cites a vendor rate-limit docs page (developer.deel.com/docs/rate-limit), which was not consulted — verify live headers.
gotchas: JSON responses only; no whole-tenant bulk-export endpoint appears anywhere in the consulted API specs
list endpoints paginate (limit/offset or cursor style depending on endpoint) — iterate to exhaustion per entity
API tokens are shown once at generation and cannot be viewed again

routes.how: Global Payroll reporting endpoints on the same REST API: GET /gp/reports/{id}/gross_to_net lists gross-to-net reports and GET /gp/reports/{id}/gross_to_net/csv downloads the report as CSV; GET /gp/legal-entities/{legal_entity_id}/reports lists payroll events per legal entity; GET /reports/payroll/cycles/{cycle_id}/gross-to-net and GET /cycles/{cycle_id}/payroll-report return categorized G2N data per payroll cycle.
requires: API token with global-payroll:read (G2N reports) or payslips:read (cycle G2N data) scope
Global Payroll product in use — these endpoints cover GP legal entities and cycles
gotchas: the CSV download is the only CSV-format export found in the consulted API specs; all other report data returns as JSON
in-app admin report builder / UI CSV exports could not be researched (help center not consulted) — verify in tenant

routes.how: Per-item document download endpoints on the REST API: GET /invoices/{invoice_id}/download (returns a link to the invoice PDF), GET /gp/workers/{id}/payslips/{payslip_id}/download and GET /eor/workers/{worker_id}/payslips/{payslip_id}/download (payslip PDF download links), GET /contracts/{contract_id}/documents, GET /eor/workers/contracts/{contract_id}/employee-agreement/download, GET /eor/workers/compliance-documents/{document_id}/download, GET /eor/workers/tax-documents, GET /workers/contracts/{contract_id}/pdf (contract PDF link). Enumerate parent entities via list endpoints, then download file-by-file.
requires: API token scopes: accounting:read (invoices), payslips:read (payslips), worker:read (agreements, compliance and tax documents), contracts:read
gotchas: download endpoints return links rather than streaming the file directly — fetch the link promptly in case it is time-limited
no bulk/archive file export is documented; extraction is strictly one file per call
several document endpoints are worker-context (worker:read) rather than org-admin context — coverage from an org token needs in-tenant verification

routes.how: Read configuration objects as JSON via the REST API: GET /people/custom_fields and GET /contracts/custom_fields (custom field definitions, plus per-worker/per-contract values), GET /contract-templates (org contract templates), GET /webhooks and GET /webhooks/events/types (webhook subscriptions and available event types).
requires: API token with the matching read scopes
gotchas: these are read-only JSON snapshots, not a documented restorable import/export package format

preservation_notes.attachments: No bulk file export documented. Payslips, invoices, contract documents, employee agreements, compliance and tax documents are each fetched per item through API download endpoints that return PDF links; plan a crawl over list endpoints then per-file downloads.
preservation_notes.config_artifacts: Custom field definitions, contract templates, and webhook subscriptions are readable as JSON via the API; no restorable import format or configuration-package export is documented in the consulted sources.

sources.title: Deel API TypeScript SDK (official npm package published by Deel public-api-eng; tarball inspected: base URL https://api.letsdeel.com/rest/v2, bearer auth, People/Contracts/Timesheets/Organizations/Webhooks APIs)
Deel Public API samples (official Deel GitHub org; confirms developer portal at developer.deel.com/docs/welcome)

API Evangelist mirror of Deel OpenAPI definitions (92 subpackage specs with vendor-authored endpoint descriptions and token scopes: reports, payslips, invoices, custom fields, SCIM, plus derived auth/rate-limit metadata)
Deel REST API OpenAPI 1.25.0 (Jentic mirror; vendor-authored auth description including in-app token generation steps: Apps & Perks > Developer Center)

notes: This recipe is built from Deel's own OpenAPI specifications and SDK obtained via mirrors (api-evangelist, jentic) and Deel's official npm package and GitHub samples — vendor-authored text, but not fetched from the live vendor portal. The following are honest unknowns, not absences in the product: (1) admin-UI per-entity CSV exports and any in-app report builder; (2) any whole-account export/backup feature; (3) audit-log export and its retention; (4) ToS/DPA export-rights language and post-termination retrieval window; (5) numeric API rate limits (a vendor page developer.deel.com/docs/rate-limit exists per mirror metadata). Verify all five against developer.deel.com and help.deel.com, and check the live tenant. SCIM-style /Users endpoints appear under the same REST base in the consulted specs.
research_caveats: All Deel-owned domains (developer.deel.com, help.deel.com, deel.com legal pages) were blocked by the research environment's network egress policy and the web-search budget was exhausted, so nothing was fetched from the live vendor portal; the recipe rests on Deel's OpenAPI specifications and SDK obtained via mirrors (api-evangelist, jentic) plus Deel's official npm package and GitHub samples. Re-verify the five listed unknowns and the vendor rate-limit page against developer.deel.com and help.deel.com from an unrestricted network.
